inventory_policy: Query only public Figshare collection/article JSON metadata and file metadata. Do not follow any file download URL and do not open any file bytes in this gate.
next_if_geometry_file_identified: freeze exact Figshare article/file identity and checksum, establish equivalence/provenance to the published patch-definition geometry, then open only that geometry file for the frozen LCC gate
stop_if_not_identified: do not open Figshare files merely to hunt for geometry; continue metadata-only mirror discovery or preserve transport-blocked status
